'theorem ncard_original {σ : Type*} (r : σ → ℕ) [Finite (Function.support r)] (B : ℕ) :
    (boxFamily r B).ncard = (B + 1) ^ ∏ᶠ j, (r j + 1) := by
  classical
  have h := Box246Generic.constant_choices (Finsupp.ofSupportFinite r (Set.toFinite _)) (Finset.Icc (0 : ℤ) B) (by simp)
  have hc : (Finset.Icc (0 : ℤ) B).card = B + 1 := by simp
  rw [hc] at h
  have he :
    (Box246Generic.family (Finsupp.ofSupportFinite r (Set.toFinite _)) (fun _ ↦ Finset.Icc (0 : ℤ) B)) =
      boxFamily r B :=
    by
    ext P
    simp only [Box246Generic.family, boxFamily, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Finset.mem_Icc]
    rfl
  rw [he] at h
  rw [h]
  congr 1
  exact
    (finprod_eq_prod_of_mulSupport_subset _ fun j hj ↦ by
        simpa [Finsupp.ofSupportFinite_support, Function.support, Function.mulSupport] using
          hj).symm' starts on column 1, but all commands should start at the beginning of the line.

Note: This linter can be disabled with `set_option linter.style.whitespace false`

'theorem strict_no_direct {σ : Type*} (r : σ → ℕ) [Finite (Function.support r)] (B : ℕ) :
    (boxFamily r B).ncard = (B + 1) ^ ∏ᶠ j, (r j + 1) :=
  by
  fail_if_success exact Finset.card_finsupp _ _
  fail_if_success exact Set.ncard_image_of_injective _ AddMonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff_injective
  fail_if_success
    solve
    | simp only [boxFamily]
  exact ncard_inline r B' starts on column 1, but all commands should start at the beginning of the line.
